name: Nordson
description: Nordson makes precision dispensing and processing equipment: the nozzles, pumps and systems that apply adhesives, coatings and fluids on diaper lines, can lines and chip-packaging lines, plus test and inspection gear for semiconductors and circuit boards. Since buying Atrion in 2024 it is also a sizeable maker of single-use medical components, catheter shafts and balloons. The business model is the installed base: equipment is sold once, then wear parts, nozzles, consumables and service follow. Gross margin is 55.2 percent and about two thirds of sales are outside the US.

businessLines.name: Industrial Precision Solutions (IPS)
businessLines.how: Sells dispensing, coating and polymer-processing equipment (industrial coatings, nonwovens such as diaper lines, packaging, precision-agriculture spraying, product assembly) to manufacturers: a system sale followed by recurring nozzles, wear parts, consumables and service.

businessLines.name: Medical and Fluid Solutions (MFS)
businessLines.how: Sells single-use plastic syringes, cartridges, tips, fluid connectors, interventional catheter components (shafts, balloons, nitinol) and cardiac-surgery consumables to medical-device makers and industrial users; repeat component orders built into customers' products.

businessLines.name: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS)
businessLines.how: Sells electronics dispensing and plasma-treatment systems, and test, inspection and measurement systems (bond testers, optical, acoustic and x-ray inspection) mainly to semiconductor and circuit-board makers: capital equipment tied to fab and packaging build-outs, plus service.

brands.name: Atrion (acquired 2024)
brands.note: Medical device maker bought in fiscal 2024; full-year effect lifted MFS sales 23.0 points from acquisitions in FY2025. Price and standalone revenue not read from the 10-K text.

brands.note: Acquisition whose impact is cited in the FY2024-versus-FY2023 results discussion; acquisition date not read from the 10-K text.
